A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and 19 complete pages, including Appendices A–C. Text comparison and rendered-page checks establish identical manuscript content; only the first-page arXiv version stamp, date and associated link differ.

before.justification: v3 reports original recursive-training experiments, regressions relating dataset properties to distribution shifts, political-lean experiments, and supplementary simulations in Appendix C.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the main-text experiments and Appendix C simulations and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The iterative training chain, accumulated-data sampling, four base-model options, LoRA fine-tuning and generation procedure are identical in Section 3 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both retain the same five Twitter/Reddit/Wikipedia datasets, OpenMEVA-ROC judge validation, mixed-domain and political-lean scenarios, and appendix toy simulations.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the comparison with Chen et al. (2023). Appendix C.4 and Figure 14 retain the same four homogeneous-model chains; no comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Training and evaluation settings match, including 20-generation chains, initial training on 8,000 samples, subsequent training on 4,000 samples, and evaluation on 250 generated texts. Appendix protocols are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The predictor-selection analysis and Appendix C studies of models per generation, dataset quality, the Wikipedia U-shaped relationship, and political-lean mechanisms are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both retain the five-seed statement in Section 3.1, the 50-simulation statement in Appendix C.3, and identical regression-significance reporting and plotted uncertainty.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings match, including Table 1 regression coefficients, Table 2 judge correlations, and the main-text and appendix experimental results. No numerical correction or changed trend is present.

T1.justification: Mathematical descriptions and assumptions are unchanged, including the sampling expressions and Appendix C.3 histogram toy model with its prior-bias assumptions. No theorem, proof or derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about dataset-dependent distribution shifts, diversity and quality predictors, domain modularity, and political-bias evolution.

C2.justification: Interpretations in the main text and Appendices A/C are identical. Limitations concerning simplified chains, small models, English text, US politics and incomplete coverage of dataset properties are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains identical preprocessing, judge prompts, clustering instructions, hyperparameters and computational-cost disclosures. Code and dataset access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list and related-work discussion are identical. The paper's novelty claims and positioning relative to earlier recursive-training research do not change.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3, dated 2 July 2025, to v4, dated 9 September 2025. Manuscript wording, headings and section organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–14 and Tables 1–2 retain identical displays, captions, labels and placement. The manuscript layout is unchanged; the marginal stamp text update is recorded under P1.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information and presentation are identical across the main text and appendices. Updating the arXiv version stamp and link does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
